text_to_speech: Hello astronomers! Today I want to show you a great observatory class telescope that Officina Stellare designed to provide large corrected image circle with an universal f7 focal ratio. This is the RiDK 400 and we created the bundle with ESATTO 4” robotic focuser! RiDK means Riccardi Dall-Kirkham and it’s an optical system based on a spherical secondary mirror with integrated corrector group that not only provides a very large corrected image circle but it is easier to collimate in respect to standard Ritchey-Chretien design. In particular, the RiDK 400 is 400mm in diameter and 2800mm focal length. The telescope weights 44kg and it has a carbon/aluminum truss tube, designed to be very stable with temperature changes. In order to bundle with our robotic focusers, we designed a specific adapter to let you connect ESATTO 4” to the M120x1.5 female thread that you have in the back cell of RiDK400. This allows you to have our high precision and load capacity robotic focuser. Officina Stellare RiDK 400 has 294mm backfocus from the rear cell and, since the ESATTO 4” plus the adapter is 95.5mm thickness, you still have 198.5mm space that allows you to use even thick imaging trains composed by many accessories. And if you add the ARCO 3” camera rotator and field de-rotator after the ESATTO 4”, you still have 174mm backfocus after the rotator. You can also add the EAGLE, for example by connecting it to the upper Losmandy style dovetail bar by using the PLUS clamp. This allows you to remotely control and power all your devices in a very easy way. I really like this RiDK 400 telescope with ESATTO robotic focuser because it provides observatory class performance, with a large corrected image circle in an easier to collimate optical design and a telescope that you can install in a 3 meter diameter dome. For more content that will help you to explore the universe like a pro, subscribe to our channel and…. clear skies!

youtube_description: Officina Stellare RiDK 400 f7 is the modified Dall-Kirkham telescope with 400mm diameter and 2800mm focal length that provides large corrected image circle and long backfocus, together with the high load capacity ESATTO 4" robotic focuser! Thanks to 298mm backfocus from telescope rear cell, you still have 198.5mm focus extraction after the focuser, so you are able to install any camera also with many accessories like off-axis guider, filter wheel, and even adaptive optics.
